title: StreamPulse DLQ record, version 1
description: A raw record the Flink job rejected, written to wikimedia.recentchange.dlq.v1. Changes within v1 are additive only (docs/adr/0005).

detail.description: Human-readable explanation, e.g. which field and why.

raw_value.description: The payload as UTF-8 text (invalid bytes replaced), at most 65536 characters.

raw_value_bytes.description: Length of the original payload in bytes.

source.description: Where the rejected record lives in the raw topic, so it can be re-read and replayed after a fix.

headers.description: The producer's sp-* headers as text.

detected_at_ms.description: Processing time of the rejection (not part of any idempotency claim).
